title: 第15章 大萧都城暗流涌动第16章 温馨镇国公府
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
数道命令迅速从那巍峨壮观、金碧辉煌的皇宫之中接连不断地发出。
这些命令有的径直冲向京兆府府衙，
有的则犹如鬼魅一般悄然没入那个充满神秘色彩的特殊机构——神捕司！
甚至还有一些命令在暗地里以一种不为人知的方式传递到了其他隐秘之地。
京都城内，各方势力盘根错节，那些潜藏于暗处的探子们宛如嗅觉灵敏的猎犬，
在第一时间便嗅到了这股不同寻常的气息，
并以最快的速度将所获取的消息传送回各自所属的势力阵营。
刹那间，
原本看似平静如水的大萧皇朝都城，仿佛被投入了一颗巨石，激起千层浪涛，
暗流也开始汹涌澎湃起来了。
就在这时，一道加急圣旨传到了京兆府府尹叶大富手中。
这位叶大人不敢有丝毫怠慢，急忙召集起了府衙内最为精锐的一批捕快。
只见他神色凝重，亲自率领这支队伍，
迈着整齐有力的步伐，浩浩荡荡地向着六皇子出事的天香楼进发。
当然，明眼人都能看得出来，叶大富此举更多的只是做做表面功夫罢了。
然而，很少有人知道，
这位京兆府府尹叶大富其实还有另外一重极为显赫的身份——他乃是大萧皇朝中赫赫有名的四大世家之一叶家之人，并且还是大皇子萧镇坚定的支持者！
若没有这样深厚的背景和强大的靠山，
恐怕他也难以稳坐这在大萧都城中虽然品阶算不上顶尖，但地位却至关重要的京兆府府尹之位。
真正负责办理此案之人，乃是陛下亲自下旨指派给大萧皇朝最为神秘、令人敬畏的特殊机构——神捕司。

要知道，过往不知有多少离奇诡异的案件，皆是由这神捕司出手侦破的。
此次出事的，毕竟是一位皇子！
虽说这位皇子身后并无强大的背景势力支撑，但奈何他自身拥有着惊世骇俗的武道天赋，实在堪称妖孽级别！
正因如此，哪怕是在萧氏皇族那帮德高望重的老家伙眼中，此子也无疑是一块备受珍视的宝贝疙瘩。
而就在昨日与六皇子凡王萧凡一同前往天香楼寻欢作乐的那些世家纨绔子弟们，亦是陆陆续续地获知了六皇子萧凡遭人下毒之事。
更为巧合的是，这起中毒事件恰恰发生在他们这帮世家纨绔子弟以及四皇子萧豹邀请六皇子萧凡光顾过天香楼之后，着实显得有些莫名其妙。
一时间，
这些平日里嚣张跋扈惯了的公子哥们，一个个都被吓得魂飞魄散、六神无主。
他们心急如焚，犹如热锅上的蚂蚁一般，团团乱转却又不知所措。
其中一些心理素质较差的家伙，
终究还是扛不住巨大的心理压力，干脆一不做二不休，径直跑去找自家老爹坦白交代了一切！
毕竟，在这大萧皇朝之中，还当真没几个人或者世家、宗门胆敢直面萧氏皇家的滔天怒火！
........
在大萧都城的繁华地段，有一座气势恢宏且美轮美奂的府邸。
这座府邸不仅占地面积广阔，而且内部各种亭台楼阁错落有致地林立着，尽显高雅与奢华之气。
此刻，在园中一处占地十几平方米的鱼塘旁边的亭榭里，
一位身着深紫色名贵长袍的中年人正悠然自得地斜躺在舒适的软椅中，手持鱼竿，专心致志地钓鱼。
content_en:
Several orders were issued quickly and continuously from the majestic and magnificent palace.
Some of these orders went straight to the Jingzhao Mansion Office.
Some are like ghosts and quietly slip into that mysterious special agency - the God Catcher Division!
There are even some orders that are secretly transmitted to other hidden places in an unknown way.
In the city of Kyoto, all forces are intertwined, and the spies lurking in the dark are like hounds with a keen sense of smell.
I smelled this unusual smell right away.
And transmit the obtained information back to their respective power camps as quickly as possible.
In an instant,
The capital of the Xiao Dynasty, which originally seemed as calm as water, seemed to have been thrown into a huge stone, stirring up thousands of waves.
The undercurrent also began to surge.
At this moment, an urgent imperial edict reached the hands of Ye Dafu, the governor of Jingzhao Mansion.
Mr. Ye did not dare to show any slightness and hurriedly summoned a group of the most elite police officers in the government office.
I saw him with a solemn look on his face, personally leading the team.
With neat and powerful steps, he marched towards Tianxiang Tower where the sixth prince had an accident.
Of course, anyone with a discerning eye can see that Ye Dafu's move is more of a superficial one.
However, few people know that
Ye Dafu, the governor of Jingzhao Mansion, actually has another very prominent identity - he is a member of the Ye family, one of the four famous families in the Great Xiao Dynasty, and he is also a staunch supporter of the eldest prince Xiao Zhen!
Without such a profound background and strong backing,
I am afraid that it will be difficult for him to firmly sit in the position of governor of Jingzhao Mansion, although his rank is not at the top in the capital of Xiao, but his status is of vital importance.
The person who is actually responsible for handling this case is the most mysterious and awe-inspiring special agency in the Great Xiao Dynasty, the Divine Catcher Division, which was assigned by His Majesty himself.
You know, there are countless bizarre and bizarre cases in the past that were all solved by this detective department.
After all, the one who got into trouble this time was a prince!
Although there is no strong background support behind this prince, he possesses astonishing martial arts talent, which can be called a monster!
Because of this, even in the eyes of the respected old guys in the Xiao royal family, this child is undoubtedly a treasured piece of treasure.
And just yesterday, the playboys from the aristocratic families who went to Tianxiang Tower with the sixth prince Xiao Fan to have fun, also learned one after another that the sixth prince Xiao Fan was poisoned.
What's more coincidental is that this poisoning incident happened exactly after they, a gang of dandies from aristocratic families, and the fourth prince Xiao Bao invited the sixth prince Xiao Fan to visit Tianxiang Tower, which seemed a bit inexplicable.
for a time,
These young men, who were used to being arrogant and domineering, were all frightened out of their wits and lost their minds.
They were anxious, like ants on a hot pot, spinning around but at a loss.
Some of these guys with poor psychological quality,
After all, I still couldn't bear the huge psychological pressure, so I just didn't do anything and went straight to my father to confess everything!
After all, in the Great Xiao Dynasty, there are really not many people, aristocratic families, or sects who dare to face the overwhelming wrath of the Xiao Royal Family!
........
In the prosperous area of the Xiao capital, there is a magnificent and beautiful mansion.
This mansion not only covers a vast area, but also has a variety of pavilions and pavilions inside, showing its elegance and luxury.
At this moment, in a pavilion next to a fish pond covering an area of more than ten square meters in the garden,
A middle-aged man in a dark purple expensive robe is reclining leisurely in a comfortable soft chair, holding a fishing rod and concentrating on fishing.
